title: Egg Dispenser for 10 eggs
author: imlostau
description:
This is an awesome egg dispenser that can hold up to 10 eggs, originally uploaded by @I.Ulianych on printables.com, and is being reuploaded under the Creative Commons (4.0 International License) Attribution license and I hope that someone will benefit from this amazing model!

Some instructions from the original creator are:

Egg dispenser hold 10 eggs from S to L sizes (up to 65x45mm).

Print recommendations:

Filament - PLA, PLA+

Layer 0.2mm, 2-3 Walls

Infill 10-15%

With Brim 5mm

The Support is not important.
